claims.text: The FDA diclofenac label lists concomitant use of diclofenac with other NSAIDs or salicylates in its drug-interaction entries.
claims.quote: Intervention: The concomitant use of diclofenac with other NSAIDs or salicylates is not recommended.

headline.text: The FDA diclofenac label lists concomitant use of diclofenac with other NSAIDs or salicylates among its interactions (c1).

reported.text: The statement covers NSAIDs as a class and does not name bromfenac, a topical ophthalmic NSAID. The bromfenac label excerpts do not mention diclofenac.

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
